limitations: One real scoped pure TypeScript module; one final run per arm, no sampling seed or broad benchmark.
Scope and map supplied equally; actual design, tasks, apply and verify agents ran. Close/delivery intentionally excluded.
409-test output case adds a synthetic valid-port matrix to a real fixture; not 409 independent product requirements.
Totals sum uncached input, output and cache read/write, not peak context. USD is runtime-estimated cost, not an invoice.
External MCP disabled equally; no local model tested.
Parent and model decisions vary; cache and latency comparisons are indicative.
Earlier attempts, failed hypotheses, reverifications and one WebSocket interruption are retained, not substituted into the controlled baseline.
Full-workflow baseline is pinned to 225f7a9; the earlier before/after exploratory homes were inherited hybrids and are excluded from the final comparison.
The independent 18-case oracle comes from the previous evaluation; it is not a newly preregistered holdout.
Previews are a Pi transport optimization; unknown/composed commands, failures, many diagnostics and unavailable storage retain native output.
Model auditing is not a deterministic proof of semantic correctness; current tests are bounded evidence.
